text.en: Pet parents highlight the warmth, deep knowledge, and patience of instructors like Vic and Janine. Reviewers particularly value the ongoing support provided between classes via email and phone calls, which helps reassure owners whenever puppy hurdles arise.

Clients report lasting progress using reward-based methods that teach clear communication without any harsh corrections. Owners of energetic puppies note dramatic turnarounds in household structure, impulse management, and reliable obedience responses.

Dog owners observe that their pets thoroughly enjoy attending training sessions and leave with stimulated, engaged minds. Reviewers appreciate the positive environment that transforms headstrong young puppies into confident, well-adjusted family companions.

q.en: What training philosophy does the school utilize?

a.en: The academy relies exclusively on positive reinforcement techniques that encourage cooperative communication without force.

q.en: Is assistance available outside of scheduled sessions?

a.en: Yes, clients highlight receiving helpful advice via phone and email between weekly classes whenever behavioral questions arise.

q.en: What class levels are available after puppy kindergarten?

a.en: Longtime patrons report progressing through multiple tiers, including intermediate obedience, trick titles, and intro to agility.

q.en: How do instructors handle high-energy puppies?

a.en: Reviewers emphasize that trainers patiently channel active dogs, establishing boundaries that bring calm structure to the home.
